citation: Dale HF, et al. Effect of a cod protein hydrolysate on postprandial glucose metabolism in healthy subjects: a double-blind cross-over trial. J Nutr Sci 2018.
protocol: Fasted; breakfast of 80 g bread, 10 g margarine, 20 g jam, 20 g cheese (355 kcal, 41 g carbohydrate, 12.5 g protein, 15 g fat) plus a casein control drink (about 145 kcal, 36 g carbohydrate) or cod hydrolysate drink; samples every 20 min to 180 min
population: n=41 healthy middle-aged to elderly men and women
note: Printed breakfast composition, SD in a table at every 20 min to 180 min; use the casein control arm. Insulin is skewed: the table also gives log means, so say which is entered.
